# No-three-in-line problem

This file is a Wikipedia-facing entry point for the formalization in
`FormalConjectures.GreensOpenProblems.«72»`.

*Reference:* [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/No-three-in-line_problem)
-/

reformulations.difference: The imported central problem expresses eventual nonattainment as `∀ᶠ N in Filter.atTop, ¬ NoKInLineFor 3 N`, using a supremum of admissible cardinalities rather than explicitly excluding configurations of 2N points.
reformulations.equivalence_argument: For k = 3, the admissible cardinalities form a nonempty set (the empty configuration is allowed), bounded by N². Thus their natural-number supremum is attained. Together with the proved pigeonhole bound of 2N, this shows `NoKInLineFor 3 N ↔ ∃ s, AllowedSet 3 N s ∧ s.card = 2 * N`. Negating this and applying `Filter.eventually_atTop` gives precisely a cutoff beyond which no such configuration exists, as described in Wikipedia's introduction. These equivalences were proved in the scratch file without sorry dependencies.
